description: The signed update manifest read by the desktop client (soyeht_protocol::update), the Mac app (UpdateCheck) and the release script (contracts/update_manifest.py). `trust` names the keys of `keys` a build carries; `expected` is the result of reading `manifest` as version `running` on `system` and `architecture` in `channel`, when the highest sequence this device has seen is `floor`. The keys are throwaway test keys. Regenerate with: uv run python contracts/test_update_manifest.py --write
